test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

Apple's success attracted the _______ of the computer giant IBM.
solution:
The correct answer is "**attention**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The sentence talks about Apple's success attracting the attention of IBM.**
 
• **"Attention" means the act of paying close or careful attention to something or someone.**(ध्यान)
 
 
• Example: You have gained the attention of the boar
